records.source_title: Company - Rieter
records.excerpt: Rieter has a history spanning more than 230 years, operates 21 production sites in nine countries, and employs around 6 300 people worldwide, approximately 9% of them in Switzerland.
records.population: Rieter Group
records.does_not_establish: Headcount and sites say nothing about how much business, if any, comes from small producers or individuals.

records.source_title: Rieter – Milestone Reached in Strategic Repositioning (ad hoc announcement)
records.excerpt: The Rieter Group closed the 2025 financial year with sales of CHF 685.1 million (2024: CHF 859.1 million), thus remaining 20% below the previous year’s period.
records.population: Rieter Group
records.does_not_establish: Group sales give no split by customer size and do not show any revenue from small mills or private buyers.

records.source_title: Rieter – Milestone Reached in Strategic Repositioning (ad hoc announcement)
records.excerpt: Owing to extraordinary restructuring expenses and transaction costs in connection with the acquisition of Barmag in the amount of CHF 54.2 million, Rieter closed the 2025 financial year with a net loss of CHF 63.4 million (2024: net profit of CHF 10.4 million).
records.population: Rieter Group
records.does_not_establish: A loss year does not show whether a small, low-cost market test would be affordable or would be ruled out.

records.source_title: Group Strategy - Rieter
records.excerpt: As market leader, more than 3 000 customers rely on Rieter technology every day to achieve more with less.
records.population: Rieter customers (spinning mills)
records.does_not_establish: The customer count does not say how many of these customers are small mills or how small the smallest one is.

records.source_title: Textile Market and Spinning Process - Rieter
records.excerpt: The world market for staple fiber machines relevant to Rieter has an annual volume of CHF 2 200 million to CHF 4 000 million. Rieter is the market leader with a share of about 30 percent.
records.population: Industrial staple-fibre spinning machinery market
records.does_not_establish: The market defined here is industrial machinery; it gives no size for hand-spinning, craft or mini-mill equipment.

records.source_title: Rieter Webshop - Rieter
records.excerpt: The webshop accesses the machine configurations available in the mill to provide a personalized order experience. It facilitates order management, enabling spinning mills to optimize their internal stock levels.
records.population: Spinning mills with installed Rieter machines
records.does_not_establish: It does not show that anyone without installed Rieter machines, such as a hobbyist or new small mill, can buy through the webshop.

records.source_title: Rieter Spinning Documentation - Rieter
records.excerpt: The documentation is aimed at spinning mill managers and technologists and serves as a reference book and aid for daily planning work. Spinning specialists and students at technical colleges and universities also benefit from this documentation.
records.population: Spinning mill managers, technologists, specialists and students
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how many copies are sold, at what price, or that any buyers are craft spinners or very small producers.

records.source_title: Rieter Calculator - Rieter
records.excerpt: The Rieter Textile Calculator is the preferred tool by many textile experts to perform textile calculations such as yarn counts, twist etc. The calculator is revised for the 64-bit technology of the IOS operating system. Download the Rieter Calculator from the Apple App Store or from this website.
records.population: Individual textile experts using a free app
records.does_not_establish: A downloadable calculator shows reach to individual users, not paying individual customers or any demand for a consumer product.

records.source_title: Com4recycling - Rieter
records.excerpt: To apply for a license, spinning mills must produce their recycled yarn on a Rieter card, draw frame and end-spinning machine. In addition, a Global Recycled Standard (GRS) certification is required.
records.population: Spinning mills producing recycled yarn
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how many mills hold the licence or whether small recycled-fibre start-ups could meet these conditions.

records.source_title: Wool Yarn Application - Rieter
records.excerpt: As wool yarns are often produced in small lots, the process requires high flexibility and reliable prevention of material mix-ups.
records.population: Wool yarn producers using Rieter winding machines
records.does_not_establish: Small lots in industrial wool winding are not the same as small producers; it does not show any offer sized for craft or farm mills.

records.source_title: Belfast Mini Mills - We grow with you
records.excerpt: Just starting out, working with a small flock, or exploring whether this is the right path for you? The Artisan line gives hobbyists, hand spinners, and small-space creators an affordable entry point — with select machines to help automate key steps and bring a little speed to your creative process.
records.population: Belfast Mini Mills, a maker of small-scale fibre processing equipment, and its hobby and small-farm buyers
records.does_not_establish: A small specialist maker's product line does not show the size of this market or that an industrial supplier could profit in it.

records.source_title: Small-scale fiber processing mills are thriving in Maine - Bangor Daily News
records.excerpt: It uses equipment designed for large quantities of wool, running 240 spindles for yarn production while a mini mill uses from six to 12.
records.population: Bartlettyarns (commercial mill) and Maine mini mills
records.does_not_establish: It compares one regional commercial mill with mini mills; it says nothing about Rieter equipment or global numbers of mini mills.

records.source_title: Small-scale fiber processing mills are thriving in Maine - Bangor Daily News
records.excerpt: “No mill in the state is looking for work,” Goundie said. The four that process all the way to yarn, including Bartlettyarns, have waitlists of at least six months.
records.population: Fibre mills processing to yarn in Maine
records.does_not_establish: Waitlists at four mills in one US state do not show demand for new equipment, or demand elsewhere.

records.source_title: Small-scale fiber processing mills are thriving in Maine - Bangor Daily News
records.excerpt: The majority of Emerman and Goundie’s customers own fewer than 20 animals that produce less than 50 pounds of fiber.
records.population: Customers of the Moorit Hill Farm mini mill
records.does_not_establish: One mini mill's customer mix does not show what such mills would pay for equipment or how many exist.

records.source_title: Small-scale fiber processing mills are thriving in Maine - Bangor Daily News
records.excerpt: Mini mills don’t affect business at Bartlettyarns. Lindsey Rice sees them filling a niche, largely for those who don’t rely on fiber as their sole source of income.
records.population: Maine mini mills and the commercial mill Bartlettyarns
records.does_not_establish: One mill owner's view of a niche does not measure its size or its growth.

records.source_title: Spinning the Wheel - RNZ
records.excerpt: Since then Ashford Handicrafts have made over 500,000 spinning wheels and 300,000 weaving looms and business is still booming.
records.population: Ashford Handicrafts, a maker of hand spinning wheels and looms, and its buyers
records.does_not_establish: Cumulative output since 1940 gives no annual sales, prices or margins, and does not show that an industrial machine maker could compete in this segment.

records.source_title: Palm sized Electric Eel mini spinning wheel - Geeky Gadgets
records.excerpt: An awesome palm sized electric spinning wheel has raised over $200,000 via Kickstarter thanks to over 1,800 backers with still 30 days remaining on its campaign.
records.population: Backers of the Electric Eel Wheel Mini 2, a small electric home spinner
records.does_not_establish: Pledges to one low-priced crowdfunded gadget in 2018 do not show current or repeat demand, or demand for anything an industrial supplier would make.

records.source_title: Craft Yarn Council (CYC) Releases 2022 Consumer Insights into Craft Yarn Purchases Report - PR Newswire
records.excerpt: Two out of five crafters in the paid sample, representing approximately 50% of the respondents, say they started crocheting within the last two years.
records.population: US residents aged 18+ who bought yarn in the previous six months (online survey, n=3,955)
records.does_not_establish: It concerns crocheters buying yarn, not people spinning their own yarn or buying spinning equipment.

records.source_title: EU rules on Textile Waste Management: A Step Towards Sustainability - EU Textiles Ecosystem Platform
records.excerpt: Member States are required to set up separate collection of textiles by 1 January 2025. For this to happen, separate collection, sorting, re-use and recycling capacities within the EU have to be strengthened.
records.population: EU Member States and the textile collection and recycling sector
records.does_not_establish: A collection duty does not show that small recycling start-ups will buy spinning equipment, or at what scale recycled fibre will be spun.

records.source_title: Materials Market Report 2023 - Textile Exchange
records.excerpt: Overall, less than 1% of the global fiber market was from pre- and post- consumer recycled textiles in 2022.
records.population: Global fibre production
records.does_not_establish: A small current share does not show whether recycled-textile spinning will grow, or how much of it will happen in small operations.

records.source_title: Rieter restructures Winterthur site - Innovation in Textiles
records.excerpt: Over the last few years, the spinning industry has continued to move to Asia. As a consequence, Rieter, the leading supplier of systems for short-staple fibre spinning, has made significant investments in China and India adding production capacities in these countries.
records.population: Short-staple spinning industry and Rieter's production footprint
records.does_not_establish: A 2015 report on where industrial spinning is located says nothing about small or craft spinners in Europe or North America.
